(3) He explosively jumps over the barbell to the other side of the green turf. (4) The scene cuts rapidly, showing him performing the same sequence of dropping down, doing a push-up, and jumping back over the bar. Several other gym-goers are visible in the background, either watching or moving through the space. (5) The man continues this rhythmic burpee-style exercise over the bar, with the camera remaining at a static, medium-full shot height.
